Professional context

Perception is part
of a bigger system.

I’m a Research Engineer at Fraunhofer IVI, working on robotic perception and aerial autonomy.

Fraunhofer IVI’s public autonomous-flight research covers environment perception, autonomous navigation, and safe landing. This institutional context is distinct from the specific contributions documented in my publications.

My publicly available collaborative research includes video segmentation, multimodal aerial sensing, semantic map correction, and mission-level agent evaluation.
